cd /app/dev && python3 - << 'PYEOF'
import time, json
from harness import *
# tel URI with many visual separators on the wire (valid, canonicalizes to digits)
tel = 'tel:+' + '-'.join(['1','202','555','0100'])
longtel = 'tel:+' + '.'.join(['1'] + ['2']*2 + ['0']*2 + ['5']*3 + ['0']*2 + ['1']*2 + ['0']*2)
print(longtel, len(longtel))
ACC = [{'id':'alice','default':'sip:alice@lab.test','aliases':['sip:alice@lab.test', longtel[:0] + 'tel:+1220055501100'[:0] + 'tel:+12025550100']}]
PEERS=[{'id':'edge','mode':'access','accounts':[]}]
w = req(from_=longtel, extra=['P-Preferred-Identity: <%s>' % ('tel:+' + '(' + '1' + ')' + '2' + '0' + '2' + '-'*50 + '5550100')])
out = run(envelope([ev(0, wire=w)], accounts=ACC, peers=PEERS))
print(out['results'][0])

# 5000 separators inside a tel user
big = 'tel:+1' + '-1' * 3000 + '23'
w2 = req(from_=big)
st=time.time()
out = run(envelope([ev(0, wire=w2)], accounts=[{'id':'alice','default':'sip:alice@lab.test','aliases':['sip:alice@lab.test']}], peers=PEERS))
print('big tel ->', out['results'][0]['decision'], out['results'][0].get('reason'), '%.2fs'%(time.time()-st))

# pathological: giant percent-encoded user in wire URI
user = '%61' * 2700   # decodes to 2700 chars -> too long
w3 = req(target='sip:' + user + '@lab.test', to='<sip:' + user + '@lab.test>')
st=time.time(); out = run(envelope([ev(0, wire=w3)])); print('giant user ->', out['results'][0]['reason'], '%.2fs'%(time.time()-st))

# pathological: giant alias in config
st=time.time()
bad = envelope([], accounts=[{'id':'alice','default':'x','aliases':['tel:+' + '1-'*400000]}], peers=PEERS)
try:
    run(bad, expect_invalid=True)
    print('giant alias rejected ok %.2fs'%(time.time()-st))
except AssertionError as e:
    print('FAIL giant alias', e)
PYEOF
